notes.title: Update regarding the development of Convicted!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, Convicted dev [i]"EinfachNurToni"[/i] here![/b]

I've created this little community post just to let all of you people interested in Convicted know that at this current point in time I'm rather busy studying and haven't really had the time to post more regular updates. I hope that's understandable for all of you, and I just wanted to let you all know that the game is STILL very much in development and planned to be released in the near future, even though I'm currently unable to tell you when exactly.

Have a great day everyone, and be sure to wishlist the game if you would like to be notified upon further updates or the game's release! :)

notes.title: Play Convicted's demo during Steam Scream Fest 2024!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys, Convicted dev [i]"EinfachNurToni"[/i] here again![/b]

Today the Halloween Steam Scream 2024 Event starts, and with it I'm reminding everyone that our demo is still (since last Steam Next Fest) online and playable, if you like!

I will try updating the game's demo to my best during the event so you can expect some minor to large changes.

So yeah, if you have questions, you can hit me up on Discord. Have a nice day and wishlist the game, please!! Byeee.

notes.title: Play Convicted's FIRST alpha demo at Steam's Next Fest 2024!
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys, Convicted dev [i]"EinfachNurToni"[/i] here![/b]

Today I'm very happy to announce that we'll be at the [b]Steam Next Fest: October 2024 Edition![/b]

If you're interested in playing our [b]alpha[/b] demo, then be sure to check it out during the [b]Next Fest week![/b] Also remember that we got a [url=https://discord.com/invite/6c57AnRvTQ]public Discord community server[/url], which is the perfect place for you to give me some feedback, bug reports, and/or new suggestions for the game!

If you have any more questions, then be sure to either write a comment or just message me on the server. Have a good rest of your day and be sure to [b]wishlist[/b] the game please, if you haven't already :)

notes.title: Convicted's first free demo week coming very soon!
notes.content:
Hi, Convicted dev "EinfachNurToni" here!

I'm very happy to announce that all of you are very soon able to test out the game's free Alpha demo. I'm currently still finishing up the details, so you can expect the release of the Alpha demo at the beginning of next week!

Be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6c57AnRvTQ]Discord server[/url] for more infos on that!

See ya! :)
